description: Where a request sent earlier (request_quote, start_company_registration, the website or a phone call) stands: received, taken by a lawyer, in contact, in progress, ordered or closed. Needs the request number and the phone or e-mail the request was sent with — the status is given only to the person who sent it.

contact.description: The phone (with country code) or e-mail given in that request

request_number.description: Request number returned when it was sent, e.g. 257

name: get_request_status
title: Status of a request
